name: Warm / cool light & colored backgrounds for photos

lead: Some people choose warm or cool light and colored backgrounds to make eye color look more vivid in photographs.
The idea comes from color-matching advice, and no studies were found.

paras: Background and light color are said to change how saturated the iris appears relative to its surroundings.
No risks beyond the limited reliability of an unstudied technique.

lead: Warm or cool lighting and colored backgrounds are photography choices that some appearance communities say can make eye color look stronger in photos by color contrast.
infobox: Boost apparent iris color in photos

paras: The claim is that backdrops or light tones opposite the iris hue make it appear more vivid in an image. This is a practitioner claim; no published study of the effect on perceived attractiveness was identified.
